sloka: ततः सुराणां तु वरैर्दृष्ट्वा ह्येनमलङ्कृतम् ।चतुर्मुखस्तुष्टमना वायुमाह जगद्गुरुः ।। ७.३६.२२ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ surāṇāṁ tu varairdṛṣṭvā hyenamalaṅkṛtam ।caturmukhastuṣṭamanā vāyumāha jagadguruḥ ।। 7.36.22 ॥

translations.english: After seeing Hanuman endowed with boons from the gods, Brahma, the preceptor of the world, with a pleased mind, spoke to Vayu.
